A little artistic license

The layout uses real OpenStreetMap building footprints and paths. Base terrain follows the public NSW 5 m elevation grid; small landscaped features are reconstructed from photos. Library and Mathews heights use a public NSW planning report; other buildings use explicit map tags where available, or labelled estimates. Façade details are reconstructed. This is an unofficial exterior-only recreation, not a current accessibility or navigation guide.
